digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and Gerrit DET criterion
propositions: Explicit review-plan on bugs with non-test file_impact must escalate from light advisory tier to full blocking LLM rubric at both enforcement seams (precheck and route_criteria) without CLI flags or schema changes
Gerrit DET criterion must block bug-fix commits with >150 non-test lines that lack a current or code-drifted cross-host attestation, reading opcert verification via trusted_env machinery

Attestation verdict classification must accept certified/stale-code/stale-head, flag compute_validity plan-review literals and op-cert verification failures, and fail open (advisory only) on unavailable/error/unknown verdicts
Non-test line classification excludes tests/** and conftest.py; all other paths (src, scripts, workflows, docs) count toward the shared 150-line threshold constant
Backtest corpus of 113 bug-fix commits must flag exactly the 13 adjudicated-substantive changes with >150 non-test lines and zero mechanical false positives
